title: Foundry local api and mcp

optionalIntegrations.description: dnd5e data access and actions are implemented (see PLAN.md Part 2, Phases 34-35): REST endpoints and MCP tools for CONFIG.DND5E reference data, a structured actor-sheet summary, actor inventory, ability/save/skill/death-save rolls, short/long rests, spell-slot spend/restore, and item use. None of this has been smoke-tested against a live dnd5e world yet (see PLAN.md's Phase 34/35 deviation-log entries for the specific field-path and method-name assumptions made). Core endpoints already work without this, regardless of game system.

recommends.reason: Not required. When the world's game system is dnd5e, this module exposes additional dnd5e-specific REST/MCP endpoints: config reference data, actor sheet summary, inventory, plus write actions (ability/save/skill/death-save rolls, rests, spell-slot spend/restore, item use) — see PLAN.md Phases 34-35. Not yet smoke-tested against a live dnd5e world.

description: Local REST API and MCP server for full remote control of a running Foundry VTT world — document CRUD, tokens, combat, dice rolling, canvas placeables, permissions, files, users, and live event streaming.
